instructions: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
MARCHWOOD COACHES - LOST PROPERTY REPORT

The journey
Service: the (1) ........ (the airport coach)
Day of travel: (2) ........
Seat: three rows from the back, on the left
The bag was left in the (3) ........ above the seat

The bag
Type: rucksack
Colour: (4) ........ , with a grey stripe on the front pocket
Inside: jumper, paperback, walking boots, camera, keys

The passenger
Surname: (5) ........
Daytime telephone: (6) ........

Collecting the bag
Bags are held for three months; after that they go to a (7) ........
Address: the depot on Canal Road
Go in by the side entrance, beside the (8) ........
Take the reference number and proof of name,
e.g. a driving licence or a (9) ........
Handling charge: £(10) ........

items.evidence: The airport coach is the four eighty-two.
items.explanation: The passenger first says four hundred and eighty-six; the assistant corrects this: that service goes to the retail park, the airport coach is the four eighty-two.

items.evidence: It was Wednesday, so the tenth.
items.explanation: The passenger first says Tuesday, then remembers that Tuesday is their day off and corrects themselves: the journey was made on Wednesday.

items.prompt: The bag was left in the (3) ........ above the seat
items.evidence: I put the bag in the rack above me
items.explanation: The bag was put in the rack above the seat and left behind there when the passenger got off; the assistant says most lost items turn up there.

items.prompt: Colour: (4) ........ , with a grey stripe on the front pocket
items.explanation: The passenger first says navy but corrects themselves at once: the navy one is their old bag; the lost bag is dark green.
The surname is spelt out letter by letter on the recording: T-H-U-R-L-B-E-C-K. It can only be answered because it is spelt out, as it is hard to spell.

items.evidence: Oh seven nine three, double four one, eight oh six.
items.explanation: The number is given in groups; 'double four' means two fours, so it is 07793 441806.

items.prompt: Bags are held for three months; after that they go to a (7) ........
items.evidence: since last year the whole lot is sent to a public auction
items.explanation: Unclaimed bags used to go to a charity, but the clerk says that since last year everything left after three months is sent to a public auction, with the proceeds going to the drivers' welfare fund.

items.prompt: Go in by the side entrance, beside the (8) ........
items.evidence: Come in by the side entrance next to the fuel pumps
items.explanation: The main gate is only for vehicles and the barrier does not lift for pedestrians; entry has to be made through the side entrance next to the fuel pumps.

items.prompt: Take the reference number and proof of name, e.g. a driving licence or a (9) ........
items.evidence: a driving licence or a bank card will do
items.explanation: Any document with the person's name on it is accepted: a driving licence or a bank card.

items.evidence: There's a handling charge of three pounds.
items.explanation: The charge was five pounds until it changed in April; it is now three pounds.
